_notes: Synthetic, shaped like the lab's root --deep reading of Ubuntu 22.04 on 2026-09-29 (3C-2a V-18); nothing in it was copied from that host but package paths.

units.root_services lists fifteen of the stock host's in-scope root services: the ten that name twelve commands without a path, snapd.aa-prompt-listener.service (enabled, no unit file), ssh, cron, rsyslog and systemd-journald. Those twelve commands and the missing unit file are units.exec_unresolved 13; the host's other root services are shaped like the four resolved ones and flag nothing. cloud-init-local.service, which the lab runs, is left out: this is the non-cloud reading (run.env.cloud_init false), and no other in-scope unit of the lab names a bare command.
sshd.options.permit_root_login is OpenSSH's compiled default prohibit-password, which the 8.9p1 sshd (no -G) prints through sshd -T as without-password.

muster.beyond.root_authorized_keys reads PASS because this is the non-cloud image (run.env.cloud_init false) and root has no key: on a cloud image cloud-init writes a forced-command key into root's authorized_keys, and that host reads FAIL.
privilege.runtime_sockets: no container runtime is installed, so every socket row is exists false and no runtime group has a member.

storage.reason: no coredump.conf on this host, so nothing sets Storage

process_size_max.reason: no coredump.conf on this host, so nothing sets ProcessSizeMax

hard_core.reason: no limits.conf line sets a hard core limit for *
